re-constituted (Regulation 20 (2), 20 (2A) of the Regulations) and the chairperson was not present at the Annual General Meeting
(Regulation 20 (3) of the Regulations) as required under the provisions of the Regulations. Based on the decision of the Board, all matters
which are required to be placed before the Stakeholders Relationship Committee for recommendation to the Board were directly placed
before the Board.
